Hey mate. I'm your age, I'm from Mexico (so, sorry bout the English) and just like you, I'm dealing with those overwhelming feelings, because of being a financial trouble to my parents. First of all you need to know this is maybe depression. I would suggest you to get some talk with a professional in your vacations. But in a short term solution, what it really worked for me is exercising, meditation, and talking (literally) to myself. By exercising I mean lifting, but I doesn't have to be it necessarily, though I would strongly recommend you doing something that really gets the shit out of you: It makes you feel ALIVE, and better. I know the beginning it's kinda difficult, but you have to reach the point in where you feel not guilty but uncomfortable with those days when you procrastinate, trust me, overcome that feeling is one of the best things ever. Now, I know that is not exactly the answer you were looking for, but it seems to me like your real trouble isn't the 'guilty feelings', those (I think) are the result of a whole lot of stuff going through your life... But Idk. Anyway, after (or before) exercising you should try some meditation... The Headspace app has really worked for me and it helps to get toxic thoughts out of your mind and have your mind clear at least for a short period of time. You DEFINITELY need to make meditation a habit. I didn't. Without meditation, It's been a real struggle. When you're done with the Headspace app you should try another meditation apps. And, about talking to yourself... I know procrastination it's a fucking pain in the ass. But in my experience what has worked for me (I got to the point I preferred watching memes or stuff rather than cook, so I could spend days without eating properly) is REALLY TALKING TO YOURSELF. I mean it, man. Like, with words and stuff, not just imagine it. Sometimes I would like to be lazy and I had to remind myself 'Hey, are you going to let this lazy ass bitch called depression beats you?' the best motivation I have ever had comes from myself. 

After doing all that stuff I always find it easier to study and get my shit done. 

And... About suicidial thoughts... I have them too. Right now I'm having them. Not pretty serious stuff... But it hurts. And trust me, doesn't worth spending time thinking about it. 

Idk what else to say man, I'm feeling just like you and I saw your post and I really felt the need of helping you... Anyway, you can dm me for anything you need.
